examples.title: Create a Switch node
examples.code:
# Create the node and keep a reference to it.
switch = nuke.createNode("Switch")

provenance.editorial_note: Node class is present in the locked scanner dataset; Foundry toolbar source is used where the class is exposed in the standard toolbar.

examples.title: Connect foreground and background inputs
examples.code:
# Connect two image streams to the node.
switch = nuke.createNode("Switch")
switch.setInput(0, foreground)
switch.setInput(1, background)

provenance.editorial_note: Generic two-input graph pattern; exact A/B semantic labels remain defined by the scanner metadata.

examples.code:
# Configure the "which" control.
switch = nuke.createNode("Switch")
switch["which"].setValue(0.5)
